svg.title: GEAR-Nav real-world and Isaac Sim scenes
svg.desc: All six existing scene views, with unchanged recorded GEAR-Nav route control points, schematic reference baseline paths, and target markers. Typography and line weights are sized for a 3.4-inch paper column. The simulation views come from separate illustrative oracle-goal runs.
